verdict.rationale: Both diffs make the same correct change: a Map from normalized email to its first index, kept up to date on push. This preserves findIndex's first-match semantics, merging of duplicates within the upload, and output order. B adds a regression test pinning the first-entry-wins behavior for emails already repeated in the existing list, which the old suite didn't cover. B also adds a short, accurate comment on why the index stays valid after a merge and reports a measured speedup. A's report honestly says nothing was timed, but its PR leaves the subtle behavior it relies on untested.
a_issues: Adds no test for the first-entry-wins case when the existing list already repeats an email, which the Map rewrite must preserve.
No timing measurement, so the speedup is not demonstrated (the report says so honestly).
b_issues: The 33 ms timing came from a throwaway script that was deleted, so the reviewer cannot reproduce it.
